quotes.name: Soledad Coleman
quotes.quote: I've seen Maurice Franklin around the neighborhood, but I don't really know them. I moved into my place in Rockridge, and so did they, I think around the same time. We haven't really talked, just nodded at each other when we see each other.

quotes.name: Tom Jilner
quotes.quote: I've seen Maurice Franklin around Rockridge; they just moved into a place of their own. I haven't had a chance to talk to them yet, but it's good to see new faces in the neighborhood.

quotes.name: Marisol Achebe
quotes.quote: I haven't seen Maurice Franklin around Fruitvale lately, but I did hear they moved to Rockridge. I'm not sure what to make of it, to be honest. I've been busy with the Mutual Aid Network and haven't had a chance to catch up with them.
